project: PAPER-R1 The Moonlit Lantern — original code-authored royal animal fairytale

sources.title: The Adventures of Prince Achmed (1926) — silhouette animation reference
sources.creator: Lotte Reiniger
sources.rights: Historical work and linked documentation; rights of each frame must be checked; no frames or characters copied

analysis.macro: Decorative profile characters read at a glance; illuminated cut stock separates figure and stage
analysis.meso: Separate small joints are pin-registered and follow stylized physical arcs
analysis.micro: Decorative negative-space cutouts in headdress/clothing; precise source measurements unavailable
analysis.motion: Moving pieces keep their silhouette; no generalized elastic morph

sources.title: Swan Lake — Paper Theatre
sources.creator: Auzou
sources.rights: Copyrighted publication photographed for sale; visual study only, no images bundled
sources.view: published theater illustration visible in product preview

analysis.macro: A crowned figure occupies a forest portal; woodland animals and water carry narrative depth
analysis.meso: Mid-distance water and trees frame the figure without burying the face
analysis.micro: Foliage edges and page shadows distinguish physical cut stock
analysis.motion: Still image; character movement cannot be inferred from source

sources.title: Knight's Stories — A Pop Up Theatre
sources.creator: Pop-up theater artist showcase
sources.rights: Artist copyright; reference only, no shapes traced
sources.medium: book pop-up scene and folded 2D figures

analysis.macro: Layered theatrical framing with a discrete hero, forest and animals
analysis.meso: Visible props, ground contact and cut cardboard edges
analysis.micro: Costume color fields and cut-paper seams rather than flat transparent cartoons
analysis.motion: Still image; no verified motion study

sources.title: Disney Sidekick Adventures — Shape & Shadow production
sources.creator: Shape & Shadow / Mighty Oak
sources.rights: Commercial animated project; cinematography/production study only, no Disney designs reused
sources.medium: stop motion down-shooter articulated paper puppets

analysis.macro: Miniature stage character blocking and expressive supporting animal parts
analysis.meso: Replacement cutouts with linked pivots and repeated character identity
analysis.micro: Independent small paper details in each limb and face
analysis.motion: Frame-by-frame stop motion reported; footage was not inspected frame by frame

sources.title: Paper carving forest lovers lamp
sources.creator: Floral Footprint
sources.rights: Copyrighted paper-sculpture product; style study only

analysis.macro: Two adult figures centered amid animals and detailed framing; balanced luminous negative space
analysis.meso: Overlapping figures separate from foreground leaves by depth and shadows
analysis.micro: Pierced details in trees and fabric, while faces remain simple

feature_targets.source_observation: Human identity reads through crowned profile, distinct garment silhouettes, nested hair and dress/coat folds
feature_targets.geometry_rule: Two distinct adult puppet bodies, independent head crowns, eyelids, hair, embroidered seams, flowing gown and tailored coat; hierarchical rigid sheet pivots
feature_targets.test_view: 16:9/9:16 chapter f130, f370, f610 1× and 3× head/hands/gown/coat

feature_targets.source_observation: Animals support story with recognizable ears, tails, antlers and wing roots instead of anonymous oval blobs
feature_targets.geometry_rule: Fox tail on common body transform, rabbit layered ears on head parent, deer branch antlers, owl hinged wings; separate nontransparent stock per material plane
feature_targets.test_view: Act 1, Act 2 and extreme/settled motion frame

feature_targets.source_observation: Real physical depth planes and forest arch protect an illuminated central aperture and legible figures
feature_targets.geometry_rule: Root branch lace from frame edges with individually constructed leaf stock; moon, castle, creek and flowers use disjoint depth and opaque materials
feature_targets.test_view: Landscape and portrait full frame at f130/f610

feature_targets.source_observation: Separate cut pieces rotate about common pins while bodies traverse stage; no ghost alpha dissolves
feature_targets.geometry_rule: PAPER-D2 parentId and explicit shared rest-sheet pivots for roots/limbs/head/ears/wings; 30 fps frame-absolute keys; opaque 24-frame paper-curtain edit
feature_targets.test_view: Frame 0,120,239; boundaries 239→240 and 479→480; normal-speed encoded test

notes.rights: Only original procedural paper geometry is included, not artistic source images or likenesses.
notes.observational_limits: Linked online previews studied; no high-resolution rights-cleared reference crops for numeric portrait fidelity, and external motion clips were not frame-sequenced. Qualitative reference-led art, not pixel likeness.
notes.quality_gate: Visual inspection and actual chapter playback are required; passing source validator and CI alone cannot prove artist-grade character faces.
detail_priorities: deer antler and owl wing continuity
